changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.comment: Link Trung Chanh 2 households to building footprints using the hamlet drawing. Provenance is kept in gis_field_building_household_import.

rollback.sql: UPDATE public.gis_field_building b SET feature_json = jsonb_set(b.feature_json::jsonb, '{properties,householdIds}', (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(v), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(b.feature_json::jsonb #> '{properties,householdIds}') v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.gis_field_building_household_import i WHERE i.building_id = b.id AND i.household_id::text = v #>> '{}')), true)::text WHERE b.id IN (SELECT building_id FROM public.gis_field_building_household_import); DELETE FROM public.gis_field_building b USING (SELECT DISTINCT building_id, created_feature_md5 FROM public.gis_field_building_household_import WHERE building_created) i WHERE b.id = i.building_id AND jsonb_array_length(b.feature_json::jsonb #> '{properties,householdIds}') = 0 AND md5((b.feature_json::jsonb #- '{properties,householdIds}')::text) = i.created_feature_md5; DROP TABLE public.gis_field_building_household_import;
